card.name: Letter I inside capitalized abbreviations
card.fires_on: The letter I (or LI) at the end or middle of an all-caps abbreviation, such as LLI, SMI, RTI or PLIAGLIS. It also fires on the I after a period in S.S.I.

modes.label: Intestine wall abbreviations
modes.description: The I or LI in LLI and ULI, the lower and upper large intestine, in dosimetry tables.

modes.label: Other capital-letter abbreviations
modes.description: The I inside other acronyms or brand names in capitals, such as SMI, RTI, S.S.I. and PLIAGLIS.
